BAGELSMOD-SIMPLE_RUNE.title: Simple Rune
BAGELSMOD-SIMPLE_RUNE.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all your basic [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-HUNTERS_BLADE.title: Hunter's Blade
BAGELSMOD-HUNTERS_BLADE.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]strength[/gold], [blue]4[/blue] [gold]dexterity[/gold], and [red]Tender[/red].
BAGELSMOD-HUNTERS_BLADE.flavor: Crafted using the shell of a mighty bug. Wears easily then repairs itself.
BAGELSMOD-INKLET_SHAWL.title: Inklet Shawl
BAGELSMOD-INKLET_SHAWL.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Slippery[/gold]. At the start of your turn, if you have [gold]Slippery[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
BAGELSMOD-INKLET_SHAWL.flavor: Comfortable and fashionable, although wearers eventually find it consumes them.
BAGELSMOD-ELEGANT_RUNE.title: Elegant Rune
BAGELSMOD-ELEGANT_RUNE.description: Upon pickup, remove [blue]3[/blue] cards and downgrade [blue]2[/blue] random cards.
BAGELSMOD-ELEGANT_RUNE.flavor: The answer was elegance. Of course.
